title: Meet Shoal
body:
Open-source Android apps.
Your content. Your colours. Your choice.
narration: Meet Shoal. Open-source Android apps for your content, your colours, and your choice.

eyebrow: One person. A familiar starting point.
title: A crowded habitat.
body:
Adverts. Sponsorships. Upgrade prompts.
One person just wants to watch.
So our little fish starts to adapt.
narration: Sometimes, watching a video feels like an obstacle course: adverts, sponsorships, and another upgrade prompt.

title: A change in the current.
body:
A Morphe-patched YouTube can change
the familiar app. But what if the whole
habitat could be designed around you?
narration: A patched app can change the familiar experience. Morphe is one independent example. We imagined a different habitat.

eyebrow: A new habitat - a separate app, not a conversion
title: Evolve into your element.
body:
The fish gather. A new app takes shape.
A Material You home, adapted to your phone.
Shoal features are free. No subscription.
narration: Our fish adapt to their surroundings, and gather into a new home. Apps designed around you.

title: Swordfish
body:
SponsorBlock, background play and picture-in-picture.
Choose available audio tracks, captions and quality.
Less interruption. More watching.
narration: Swordfish brings SponsorBlock, background playback, picture in picture, and available audio tracks to YouTube viewing.

title: Clownfish
body:
A Reel in one chat. A TikTok in another.
Shorts when you want to switch off.
Three services. One app. Familiar tabs.
narration: Clownfish brings Shorts, TikTok and Reels into separate tabs, with the services own pages and account requirements.

title: Pufferfish
body:
Your music, mixes and playlists.
Offline downloads. Lyrics when available.
A player coloured by your album art.
narration: Pufferfish plays YouTube Music, with playlists, offline downloads, and lyrics when they are available.

title: Blobfish
body:
A Material You home for Bluesky.
Your feeds, conversations and community.
A familiar place to join in.
narration: Blobfish offers a Material You home for Bluesky, your feeds, conversations, and community.

title: Anglerfish
body:
Reddit, with a Material home around it.
Browse communities without get-the-app nags.
Reddit pages and account rules still apply.
narration: Anglerfish wraps Reddit in a Material home. Reddit pages, sign-in requirements, and restrictions still apply.

title: Shoal
body:
Install and update the family.
Manage connected accounts.
Silent installs need supported tools or permissions.
narration: Shoal installs and updates the family, and manages connected accounts. Silent installation needs supported permissions or tools.

title: Free to swim.
body:
Simple creatures. A vast ocean.
Adapting to their surroundings.
We want apps to feel like a natural habitat.
narration: Fish adapt to their surroundings and thrive in a natural habitat. That is the idea behind Shoal.

title: Free to stay.
body:
Shoal features are free. Donations are optional.
No advertising profiles added by Shoal.
Connected services keep their own rules.
narration: Shoal features have no paywalls. Donations are optional. Connected services may have their own charges and restrictions.

title:
By the community.
For the community.
body:
Built in the open. Shaped by the people
who use it. There is room for you here.
narration: Built in the open. Shaped by the people who use it. By the community, for the community.

title: Find your shoal.
body:
Get the apps. Read the source. Help build.
shoalapps.github.io
narration: Find your shoal at shoal apps, dot GitHub, dot I O. Everyone is welcome.
